evidence: Source inspection before r2 edits. Locations refer to the inherited source.
scope: All valid packed decode calls from apa_packed.py. Native r2 extensions are listed because the same compiled edit sites serve them and the inherited G2 calls use them.

public.bounds: G = H/KVH is any positive integer satisfying H % KVH == 0 and native shape/range checks. VD is 1 through 512. CAP uses max(D,VD). Neither diagnostics nor B, S, sinks or causality changes the packed norm consumer.
public.excluded: Public margin lookup refuses non-FP32. PACKED_FORMAT is tq4 at apa_packed.py:52. L != 1 enters packed_prefill, and dense keys enter the dense route.

chain: tensor_cuda/src/bindings.cpp:2785-2793 unpacks codes, scales, rotation and codebook
tensor_cuda/src/apa_spo/spq4.cuh:457-469 r2 returns directly to apa_spq1_run
tensor_cuda/src/apa_spo/packed_launcher.cuh:92-102 forwards scales as pscale and fixes baseline=false, dots=ordered
tensor_cuda/src/apa_spo/launcher.cuh:299-321 ordered selection and merge consume bulk scores and never read scales
native.excluded: Native FP16 is refused by the packed K and query checks (packed_launcher.cuh:8-10,30), despite the general ordered core admitting it.
native.hooks: The default F1/F2 builds have hooks off. In a hooks build TC_APA_SPQ1_REFERENCE=1 selects bulk for G=4 or 8 as well (launcher.cuh:261-267). No extra norm load is reachable.

loads.load: D64 loads once per key in its thread. D128 loads once per key in lane 0 and broadcasts.

loads.load: One fp32 scale per key in each tile copied into shared norms[tid]. The template is independent of q dtype and diagnostics. D and tq are runtime arguments.
loads.G2: G=1, both D, both dtype and both prefill diagnostic settings (8)
